import warnings; warnings.filterwarnings('ignore')
from scipy.optimize import least_squares
t=df['t'].values; P=df['P'].values; y=df['dP_dt'].values
def run(g,nb,trials=25):
    best=None
    for s in range(trials):
        x0=[4.018,-1.0198,-0.4233,3.1325]+list(np.random.randn(nb)*0.5)
        try:
            r=least_squares(lambda p: p[0]*np.sqrt(P)+p[1]*P*np.sin(p[2]*t+p[3])+g(p[4:])-y,x0,max_nfev=3000)
            c=np.sum(r.fun**2)
            if np.isfinite(c) and (best is None or c<best[0]): best=(c,np.round(r.x,4))
        except Exception: pass
    return best
print('lin+tExp', run(lambda q: q[0]*t+q[1]*t*np.exp(-q[2]*t)+q[3],4))
print('pow+lin', run(lambda q: q[0]*t**q[1]+q[2]*t+q[3],4))
print('lin+sin', run(lambda q: q[0]*t+q[1]*np.sin(q[2]*t+q[3])+q[4],5))
print('lin+cos', run(lambda q: q[0]*t+q[1]*np.cos(q[2]*t)+q[3],4))
print('lin+sqrtt', run(lambda q: q[0]*t+q[1]*np.sqrt(t)+q[2]*t*t+q[3],4))
print('lin+exp', run(lambda q: q[0]*t+q[1]*np.exp(q[2]*t)+q[3],4))
